why_refused: Not a generic name (detector false positive on '_Code'): 'Region_Code' is the domain noun -- the two-pin area strap on Port H bits 2:1 (MAME's AREA 'Area Selection' DIP, ../technics-docs/mame-emulation-gaps.md), stored at RAM 0x0C06 as 1..4. The routine is a shared include also assembled in v10/v9/v7 maincpu (shared/boot_routines.s, same name); a table_data-only rename would split one routine's name across trees. If the detector must be silenced, respell it in all four trees together (e.g. DetectRegionCode); no meaning would be gained.
